description: The main window on agentes.chat (servers.rs adds the same for another server's origin, at runtime): it may drag and zoom the window from its title bar, and ask this computer what `this_mac` relays (status, pairing after the system's own dialog, reconnect, a Preferences tab, the access requests, the badge, notifications). Its right-click menu may be drawn by the system (`context_menu`). It says when it painted (`page_ready`, the cover goes). No other app command, nothing else of this computer.
